title: Fact or Fiction? Can LLMs be Reliable Annotators for Political Truths?

bias_targets.methodology: Using open-source Large Language Models (LLMs) as annotators in zero-shot and five-shot settings to classify North American political news articles as either factually correct or factually incorrect. The annotations are evaluated using reference-based metrics against a human-verified gold standard dataset and through an LLM-as-a-judge framework.
